source_caption_data.pre_caption: This video captures a dramatic landscape scenery shot, emphasizing the immense scale and atmosphere of a powerful weather event rather than a specific main subject. A colossal, dark, and ominous storm cloud, tinged with a deep teal-green, dominates the sky, stretching across the entire horizon. From its turbulent base, a bright, purple-white bolt of lightning strikes down towards the ground. Below this menacing sky, a vast and flat prairie, rendered in a vibrant, almost fluorescent green, extends into the distance where the faint silhouette of a small town can be seen. The composition's focus on the sheer size of the storm system relative to the flat earth below creates a sense of awe and highlights the power of the natural environment.
